_about: Minimal reconstruction of d1preservation's capture-rig/guest-symbols.json, which the public repo references but does not ship. Every entry names where its value came from. Built 2026-10-10 for the Windows port (shadgames/tools/d1guest_win.py).

build.source: BOOTSTRAP.md pinned target; matches this machine's dump

anchors.name: job_system_init
anchors.source: fn 0x1003D0 (calls the worker entry 0xFAD30); unique in the eboot, no 0x64 TLS prefix, not patched

anchors.name: heartbeat_thread_entry
anchors.source: Graphics Heartbeat thread entry (created at 0x7E4786); unique, no TLS prefix, not patched

verify.source: job worker entry that sets TLS ctx (0xFAD66 -> 0xFC540); unique, shifted window differs

liveness.source: d1guest.py usage text (obj 4:0 = the account object); D1_ACCOUNT_SOID default in run-boot.sh

registry_layout.source: d1-live/src/fixture.rs fallback values (the real file was not published). Verified live 2026-10-10 in orbit: `live` L3 PASS, account fam4/t0 key == 0xD100000000000001 through this layout. Other families unchecked (no static family table).

symbols.name: object_registry_ptr
symbols.source: design/eboot-map.md row 0x26A2040 'the object registry'; d1-live addr.rs test

symbols.name: package_registry_global
symbols.source: capture-rig/scenario-checksum.py docstring, FUN_00299100 disasm: lea rcx,[rip+0x17722ae] -> 0x1A0B420 'the package/tag registry global'; mov rcx,[rcx]; mov rsi,[rcx] = registry base (d1guest.package_registry reads it the same two-deref way)

symbols.name: fade_block_ptr
symbols.source: design/GUARDIAN-IN-WORLD.md: [0x2694B90] -> fade block (+0x00 count, +0x14 mode, +0x18 alpha)

symbols.name: flyin_suppress_ptr
symbols.source: design/GUARDIAN-IN-WORLD.md: [0x26A33E8] deref byte0 = 1, held every ~2 s
